# hosttracker_status_page (Data Source)

Reads one status page with its settings and component set, by id or by slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By slug, which is the page's permanent public address and unique across
# the product.
data "hosttracker_status_page" "acme" {
  slug = "acme-status"
}

# Or by id.
data "hosttracker_status_page" "by_id" {
  id = "6b1f2a70-3c8e-4d51-9f2a-7c4e5d6b8a90"
}

output "acme_public_url" {
  value = data.hosttracker_status_page.acme.public_url
}

# The monitors the page publishes, third-party components left out.
output "acme_published_monitors" {
  value = [
    for component in data.hosttracker_status_page.acme.components :
    component.monitor_id if !component.third_party
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The page's id. Name it, or name the `slug` instead.
- `slug` (String) The page's permanent public address. Name it, or name the `id` instead.

### Read-Only

- `component_count` (Number) How many components the page publishes.
- `components` (Attributes List) The components the page publishes, in display order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--components))
- `created` (Number) When the page was created, in Unix seconds.
- `custom_domain` (String) The custom domain as configured, when there is one.
- `has_password` (Boolean) Whether the page is behind a password.
- `public_url` (String) Where the page is served from: `https://status.host-tracker.com/<slug>`.
- `settings` (Attributes) How the public page looks and behaves. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))
- `title` (String) The heading the public page carries.
- `unresolved_incidents` (Number) How many of the page's declared incidents are still open.

<a id="nestedatt--components"></a>
### Nested Schema for `components`

Read-Only:

- `group` (String) The heading this component is listed under.
- `manual_state` (String) The state pinned on a third-party component: `operational`, `degraded` or `down`.
- `monitor_id` (String) The monitor whose state this component shows. Null on a third-party component.
- `name` (String) The label shown on the page.
- `third_party` (Boolean) True for a component this account does not monitor.


<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Read-Only:

- `announcement` (String) A banner shown above the components, at most 500 characters. Write `""` to remove it.
- `auto_add_monitors` (Boolean) Add newly created monitors to this page automatically. Leave it off when Terraform owns `components`: a monitor the API adds by itself is a component the next plan proposes to remove.
- `dark_logo_url` (String) The logo used when the page renders dark.
- `density` (String) How tightly the component rows are packed: `wide` or `compact`.
- `favicon_url` (String) The icon browsers show for the page.
- `features` (Set of String) The page's WHOLE feature set - writing it replaces what is there, and a feature not listed is off.
- `google_analytics_id` (String) A Google Analytics measurement id (`G-XXXXXXXX`).
- `header_bg_color` (String) The header's background colour, spelled `#rrggbb`.
- `header_text_color` (String) The header's text colour, spelled `#rrggbb`.
- `hide_branding` (Boolean) Hide the HostTracker attribution, where the plan allows it.
- `homepage_url` (String) Where the page's logo and title link to.
- `language` (String) The language the public page is rendered in: `en`, `cs`, `de`, `es`, `fr`, `it`, `ja`, `nl`, `pl`, `pt`, `ru`, `tr`, `ua`, `zh`.
- `logo_alignment` (String) Where the logo sits in the header: `left` or `center`.
- `logo_url` (String) The logo shown at the top of the page.
- `robots_index` (Boolean) Allow search engines to index the public page.
- `show_groups` (Boolean) Render components under their group headings.
- `sla_target` (Number) The uptime percentage the page measures its components against, between 0 and 100. Leave it out for each monitor's own target.
- `theme` (String) Which palette the page renders in: `light` or `dark`.
- `theme_color` (String) The page's accent colour, spelled `#rrggbb`.
